summary: Round 12 testing completed. All 4 issues verified: (1) PreviewPdfDialog component working with all required data-testid attributes, (2) PDF preview opens in-page modal dialog (NOT popup/new tab), (3) Download PDF button triggers file download from dialog, (4) Smoke regression tests pass. Fixed iframe content rendering issue - added 100ms delay for iframe mount.

issue_1_preview_pdf_dialog.details: PreviewPdfDialog component at /app/frontend/src/components/PreviewPdfDialog.jsx is mounted in App.js (line 28, 83). Dialog has all required data-testid attributes: pdf-preview-dialog, pdf-preview-title, pdf-preview-iframe, pdf-preview-print, pdf-preview-download, pdf-preview-close. Toolbar shows 'Print / Save as PDF' (blue) and 'Download PDF' (yellow) buttons.

issue_2_preview_path.details: Clicking PDF button on Quotation/Tax Invoice opens in-page modal dialog (NOT a new tab/popup). Dialog is 95vw x 92vh Radix Dialog. Verified with data-testid='pdf-preview-dialog' becoming visible. No direct file download triggered on click.

issue_3_force_download.details: Download PDF button inside dialog calls downloadHtmlAsPdf with forceDownload:true. Successfully downloaded Quotation-QUO000081.pdf (577,397 bytes). File contains substantial content confirming HTML was passed correctly.

bug_fix_applied.issue: Iframe content was not rendering - document.write() was called before iframe was fully mounted in DOM

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: DialogContent missing aria-describedby - shows console warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Consider adding DialogDescription component.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Round 12 PDF preview feature verified. PreviewPdfDialog component listens for 'mecsmart:preview' custom events and renders printable HTML in iframe. Fixed timing issue where iframe content wasn't rendering - now uses 100ms delay. Download PDF button works correctly. All CRM document types (Quotation, Proforma, Tax Invoice, Packing List) use preview:true option which triggers the in-page dialog instead of popup.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The useEffect that writes HTML content to the iframe was executing before the iframe element was fully mounted in the DOM. The iframeRef.current was available but the contentDocument was not ready to accept document.write() calls.
reproduction_steps: 2. Click PDF button on any quotation row
3. Dialog opens but iframe shows gray background with no content
4. Download PDF button still works (uses React state, not iframe)
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Added 100ms setTimeout delay before calling document.write() to ensure iframe is fully mounted. Also added try-catch error handling and null checks for contentDocument access.
